answer: Proof-of-stake bonding makes each agent lock collateral before it can take jobs or vote. Sybil identities multiply cost, since every fake agent must post its own stake, and misbehavior triggers slashing that burns the stake. Crystal-clear accounting shows attackers that spreading capital across many identities only dilutes their returns. Copper-wire style cheap identities are priced out, and a whisper of collusion evidence can trigger slashing for all linked accounts.
